about: Maps the 16 muscle codes of content/exercises.json (Content §5) onto the region names of xnk-source/figure.min.json (muscle map) and the muscle marks of the rigs. Region forms: "region" = both views; "front:region" / "back:region" = that view only; a name in split = part of another region (see split). On a rig, a view prefix is dropped and a split part uses its from region (rigs have one delts mark and no oblique mark). Starts from the D-05 mockup mapping (docs/mockups/mock.js MM_MAP). C-08: upper back moved from LATS to TRAPS. C-08b (schema 2): deltoid heads split by view (the package has one deltoid shape per view: the front view shows the anterior and lateral part, the back view the posterior and lateral part); obliques split from abs by the original react-muscle-highlighter 1.2.0 slugs, without new shapes. QUADS keeps adductors (owner stand-in for LEGISO_ADD); GLUTES keeps abductors (OpenStax 2022 §11.6). See Content §5.2. The app colours the map and the rig from exercises.json muscles through this file, never from the rig own muscle list. A region that two codes share takes the stronger level (main over helper). shared = codes that land on the same region, so the figure cannot tell them apart.

obliques.source: These abs paths of xnk-source/figure.min.json are byte-identical (after whitespace) to the react-muscle-highlighter 1.2.0 slug obliques (dist/esm/assets/bodyFront.js and bodyFemaleFront.js); the rest are its slug abs. XNK merged both into abs. Compared 2026-11-19 (C-08b). The region abs then means the remaining paths.
